quote: New Fortress Energy Inc. (NASDAQ: NFE) (“NFE” or the “Company”) today announced that it has finalized and executed an engineering, procurement and construction contract (the “EPC Contract”) with a consortium formed by Mitsubishi Power Americas and Andrade Gutierrez (the “MHI/AG Consortium”) for a 1.6 GW power plant to be built adjacent to the Barcarena LNG terminal.
note: Opened NFE IR HTML; 1.6 GW Portocem EPC NTP; COD ≤ Aug 2026; CapEx blank.
